Definition: to storm; by implication, to shiver, i.e. fear
BiblicalUsage: 1) to storm, shiver, dread, bristle (with horror), be very afraid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bristle (with horror); 1a2) to dread; 2) to storm away, sweep away, whirl away; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to sweep away; 2a2) to storm away (of God's action against the wicked) (fig); 2b) (Niphal) to be stormy, be tempestuous (exceedingly); 2c) (Piel) to whirl away, be stormed away; 2d) (Hithpael) to storm against, come as a storm
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
